restaurantName: La Table du Marquis au Château de Maubreuil
bio: The illustrious history and pageantry of this romantic castle dating from the 19C can be felt both in the grounds, dotted with works of art, and in the plush, stylish interior (huge mirrors, carved fireplaces, parquet floors and Napoleon III-style furnishings). All that remains is to enjoy the well-crafted food, fully in tune with today’s tastes and palates....
pageTitle: La Table du Marquis au Château de Maubreuil
